title: Excavator
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.256-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 16 (36C256)
description_text: The Contractor shall procure and provide delivery of a Compact/Mini Excavator meeting the following requirements: • Air-Conditioned Cab • Hand Controls • Integrated Display • Digger Bucket • Integrated Dozer Blade • Soft Turf/Rubber Tracked • Swinging Boom with Full 360 Degree Rotation Carriage • Hydraulic Operation • Diesel Engine • Power Minimum: 40hp • Dig Depth Minimum: 10’ • Ground Level Reach Minimum: 15’ • Dump Clearance Minimum: 10’
